data.name: 江湖大镖客
data.detailed_description:
Jianghu Bounty Hunter is a solo-developed open-world wuxia management game on Steam. It integrates caravan management, survival resource gathering, faction warfare, and tower defense auto-battler strategy gameplay. Powered by a dynamically interconnected living world system, it presents a vivid, unrestrained martial arts jianghu full of possibilities.

1. Core Lore

During the chaotic Spring and Autumn Period, Fan Li forged an unparalleled divine treasure — the Zhu Tao Mechanism Boat. Endowed with incredible power, the boat helped the State of Wu restore its dynasty and end turmoil. After achieving greatness, Fan Li retired from public life. Using the boat’s ingenious mechanism technology, he dominated commerce and became the wealthiest sage of his era.

Hundreds of years later, a Taoist priest from the Kongtong Sect discovered the sealed ancient vessel in a remote mountain cave while surveying feng shui. Harnessing its heaven-defying power, he reshaped the jianghu, conquered rival forces, unified the realm, and founded the Wu Dynasty, later honored as the Wu Ancestor.

Knowing the boat’s power was too formidable and would trigger endless conflicts if leaked to the world, the Wu Ancestor resealed the artifact in an unknown hidden realm to secure lasting peace.

As times changed and chaos returned to the jianghu, you awaken in the ruins of a massacred escort bureau with all memories lost. Guided by the old bureau accountant, you rediscover the long-lost Zhu Tao Mechanism Boat. Embark on a journey to revive your fallen escort agency and rise amid the turbulent martial arts world.

2. Core Game Systems

2.1 Immersive Survival & Management

Experience realistic caravan simulation and meticulous bureau operation. Manage your guards’ daily lives, accommodation, and salaries. Poor resource supply, administrative negligence, or low team morale will deplete your Jianghu Reputation. Once reputation drops to zero, your bureau collapses and the game ends.

Explore freely on foot or aboard your Mechanism Boat. Gather lumber, stone, fish, herbs and more. All resources can be sold directly or processed into advanced crafts and supplies. Build your own industrial chain for self-sufficiency and profitable trading.

2.2 Dynamic Interconnected World System

The first chapter unlocks the entire Shu Region map, including 5 distinctive towns, dozens of resource-rich villages, and 15 influential sects. The whole world operates on a fully dynamic interconnected system where weather cycles, ecological changes, and commodity economies interact and influence one another in a real-time simulated ecosystem.

Weather conditions affect exploration efficiency, trade route safety, and resource yields. Ecological abundance directly impacts market supply, driving real-time price fluctuations. Local specialties, sect goods, and rare relic resources circulate dynamically. Capitalize on shifting markets and chaotic situations to accumulate wealth and dominate regional trade.

2.3 Customizable Mechanism Boat — Mobile Stronghold

The Zhu Tao Mechanism Boat serves as your upgradable, fully customizable mobile base. Redesign cabin layouts, build production lines, install processing facilities, and unlock advanced crafting formulas.

Manage resource stockpiles, arrange production schedules, and assign guard manpower rationally. Achieve mass production of daily materials and combat supplies. Transform the ancient artifact into your portable production hub and unshakable jianghu fortress.

2.4 Tower Defense + Auto-Battler Hybrid Combat

Innovatively combining tower defense deployment and auto-battler strategy. Build various defensive towers and combat devices on your deck, each with unique attributes and skills.

Towers feature exclusive synergy bonds. Level up to unlock new affixes and advanced bond effects. Mix offense, crowd control, defense, and support to create countless unique combat builds. Adjust formations tactically to fend off bandit raids and sect sieges.

2.5 Global Faction Conquest System

Every village and sect on the map is conquerable. Each stronghold provides exclusive specialties, resources, and geographical advantages. Occupy territories to monopolize local production and control vital trade routes for unique development bonuses.

Expand your influence like map coloring. Grow from a ruined small bureau into a dominant force, seize villages, subdue sects, and eventually unify the entire Shu territory to build your own jianghu empire.

2.6 Ultimate Open-World Freedom

No fixed storyline or forced moral alignment shapes your fate. You can walk the righteous path, escort caravans, uphold justice, and earn legendary fame. Or embrace chaos: steal from towns, cheat in gambles, ambush merchants, plunder villages, and occupy mountains as an outlaw overlord.

Freely engage in duels, faction wars, trade competitions, or rural seclusion. Every choice crafts a unique life in this truly open and diverse wuxia world.
